description: Wellness has become an increasingly prominent part of Korea's lifestyle scene, attracting both locals and tourists. The trend, particularly centered around saunas, encompasses beauty, food, cultural experiences and a range of health and relaxation practices. Enzyme baths are one of the latest trends, having gained attention after celebrities including actors Oh Yeon-seo and Hwang Jung-eum, singers Hyeri and Hwasa and model and TV personality Han Hye-jin shared their experiences on social media.
